Test audio, real human speech at 16 kHz mono, from the openWakeWord repository

- `hey_mycroft_test.wav`: `tests/data/hey_mycroft_test.wav`
- `office_lights.wav`: `notebooks/training_tutorial_data/turn_on_the_office_lights_test_clip.wav`

Kokoro-82M v1.0 (Apache-2.0) clips from go-phonmatchnet v0.1.0's test
fixtures, at 16 kHz: `<voice>-hey-computer.wav` and `<voice>-hey-commuter.wav`
for the voices `af_heart`, `am_michael` and `bf_emma`.
